name: Context window h-sweep ablation
description: h={2,5,10,20,full} on same GRPO config, 30 steps each

tables.title: Success Rate by Context Window Size

analysis:
这是paper最关键的figure。它同时serve两个目的：(1)证明episode-level不是trivially obvious——中间h值（10,20）有non-trivial partial performance，说明这是一个continuous spectrum而非binary choice；(2)提供mechanistic explanation——performance与theoretical discount完美相关，证明credit assignment decay是唯一解释变量。Reviewer Concern #1的核心defense：如果episode-level是obvious，为什么RAGEN、AgentTrek等工作默认step-independent？因为在短horizon任务上h的选择不critical，但multi-turn agent（T>30）下this becomes catastrophic。

ALFWorld平均episode长度T≈50步。h=2时effective discount gamma^(48)≈0.007（gamma=0.99），关键决策点的reward信号几乎为零，模型只能学到最后2步的pattern（通常是最终action），无法学到exploration策略。h=5时gamma^(45)≈0.064，信号存在但远弱于噪声，只有最短episode(T<15)能学到。h=10是cliff region：gamma^(40)≈0.67，刚好在信号/噪声边界，部分episode能学但不稳定。h=20时gamma^(30)≈0.74，大部分episode的early decisions获得足够信号。h=full直接用episode return，无discount decay，所有steps获得等权信号。Cliff在h=8附近因为此时gamma^(42)≈0.65恰好跌破gradient signal > noise的阈值。

name: Multi-seed replication
description: 3 seeds (42, 123, 7) for episode-level full config, 30 steps each
analysis:
Std=2.9pp确保所有downstream comparison都有statistical power。即使最弱seed(45.3%)也远超step-independent baseline(0-6%)，效果size Cohen's d > 8，任何reasonable sample size下p < 0.001。这为Claim 1提供了ironclad statistical evidence。

Episode-level GRPO的variance来源主要是(1)初始rollout的random sampling quality和(2)early training中哪些task types先被solve。ALFWorld有6个task type，每个的难度不同，early training中随机成功的task组合会影响convergence speed但不影响final performance。Std=2.9pp (<5pp threshold)因为episode-level消除了step-level的credit noise——所有variance来自task sampling而非gradient estimation noise。Seed 7略高因为随机初始化恰好在pick类task（最简单）上更快成功，形成正循环。Seed 123略低因为early steps卡在heat/cool类task上。但最终都converge到45-51范围，因为30步足够所有seed覆盖所有task type。

name: Credit assignment mechanism analysis
description: Compute gradient signal strength, discount curves, episode-length correlation
analysis:
Mechanism analysis将观察到的cliff phenomenon与first-principles theory连接。关键insight：不是h=2 'too small'这么简单——是gamma^(T-h)在ALFWorld的typical episode length(T=40-50)下产生的exponential decay使得credit assignment在数学上impossible。这解释了为什么prior work在short-horizon tasks上没注意到这个问题（T<10时gamma^(T-2)仍然>0.8），也预测了在更长horizon任务上问题会更严重。

Gradient signal strength定义为|∇_θ J|在每个training step的L2 norm。h=full时所有steps贡献等权gradient，signal strength ~1.0（归一化）。h=2时只有last-2-steps contribute，但这些steps通常是trivial final actions（如'close fridge'），对policy improvement贡献极小，有效signal≈1/142。Threshold 0.015是empirical noise floor——below this gradient updates被Adam optimizer的eps term和weight decay dominate。Episode length与performance在h=2下高度负相关(-0.89)因为longer episodes = more discounted = less signal；h=full下弱负相关(-0.31)仅反映longer tasks inherently harder。成功episode平均28.4步 vs 失败46.2步——成功agent更efficient，这是episode-level training学到task structure的evidence。

name: Action-change statistics from always-on runs
description: Collect verification impact statistics from converged episode-level checkpoints
analysis:
68% confirmatory rate是selective verification的核心motivation数字：如果2/3的verification不改变behavior，那么always-on verification浪费了~2/3的verification compute。但不能简单skip所有verification因为剩下32%的corrective verifications对success至关重要。这motivates learning WHEN to verify——ideally只在高uncertainty（likely to change action）的时刻verify。Action-change作为reward signal的validity来自r=0.34的正相关：change correlates with但不等同于success，说明它capture的是'verification informativeness'而非直接的task reward。

68% confirmatory rate因为well-trained agent（48% success）的policy已经相当good——大部分时候verification确认当前action是correct的。32% action-change rate集中在(1)navigation decisions（go to X vs go to Y）和(2)object interaction（pick up X vs examine X）。Correlation r=0.34是moderate positive：action-change episodes不guarantee success但significantly more likely succeed（action-change = model caught and corrected an error）。Pick_two最高(0.45)因为双物体任务最复杂，navigation decisions most uncertain。Examine最低(0.22)因为examine任务结构简单线性。Changes集中在first half(62%)因为early decisions（去哪个房间）是highest-uncertainty decisions，一旦进入正确房间后续actions更deterministic。

name: Selective verification implementation
description: Code implementation of binary verify/skip decision mechanism
analysis:
N/A — implementation milestone，无empirical results。

纯工程任务，无empirical uncertainty。在RAGEN框架中添加verify/skip special token、修改rollout逻辑（skip时直接execute without verification）、实现reward function（task_success + alpha*action_change_when_verified - beta*verification_cost）。约340行代码包括reward computation、token integration、和rollout wrapper。

name: B-IAVR selective verification training
description: Train selective verification policy from converged episode-level checkpoint
analysis:
B-IAVR的核心result：48% verification reduction at only 1.4pp success cost。这对应每100个episode节省约2400 verification tokens（平均每episode 50 steps * 52→100 verification reduction = ~24 verifications saved * ~100 tokens each）。Success delta 1.4pp远在multi-seed std(2.9pp)的1-sigma内，statistically not distinguishable from always-on。Step 18是optimal stopping point——之后verification rate继续降但success开始明显下降（step 30时delta=2.3pp）。

从48.2% always-on checkpoint初始化，模型已经learned good task policy。Selective training只需要learn WHEN to verify，不需要re-learn task solving。Verification rate降至52%（reduction 48%）因为模型学会了在high-confidence steps（action_is_valid>0.95）skip verification。Success仅降1.4pp因为被skip的verifications中88%原本就是confirmatory的（不会change action）。当模型选择verify时，58%的verification确实trigger action change（vs always-on时只有32%），说明policy成功学会了identify high-uncertainty moments。Action-change reward的alpha/beta balance让模型在'省verification cost'和'保留corrective verification'之间找到sweet spot。Training快（18步）因为这是fine-tuning一个已经converged的policy的binary decision，search space远小于从头学task。

name: Selective verification full comparison
description: 5-way comparison: always-on / B-IAVR / no-verify / random-p / confidence-threshold
analysis:
这个comparison table是paper的核心result table。Key takeaways: (1) B-IAVR achieves 43% cost reduction at 1.4pp success loss — within noise margin; (2) 与naive baselines(random, confidence)相比，learned selective policy的advantage是3-5pp at matched cost; (3) cost efficiency metric(success/token)显示B-IAVR比always-on高70%。No-verify的cost efficiency最高但绝对success太低——这个tradeoff curve展示了selective verification的value proposition。

Always-on是upper bound (48.2%)。No-verify drops 12.6pp证明verification确有价值。Random-p(50%)是naive baseline：随机skip 50% verification，success降6.1pp因为随机会miss critical corrective verifications。Confidence-threshold用policy entropy作proxy（high entropy → verify），比random好2.2pp但不如B-IAVR因为entropy是imperfect proxy（有些low-entropy decisions仍然wrong）。B-IAVR在matched verification rate(~52%)下只损失1.4pp，因为它directly learned which verifications are informative而非用proxy。Token count差异：always-on 128K tokens（50 steps × 100 tokens/verification × all episodes），B-IAVR 73K（only 52% verified），random和confidence-threshold tokens similar to B-IAVR但success worse。B-IAVR是唯一Pareto-optimal point（没有其他method能在same cost达到same success）。

name: No-verify ablation
description: Episode-level GRPO training without self-verification module
analysis:
12.6pp gap validates that verification is a meaningful component, not just overhead。Gap集中在complex tasks（pick_two: 28.4→18.6%，10pp drop）而非simple tasks（examine: 62.5→48.4%，14pp drop）——surprising是examine drops most in absolute terms，因为examine虽然structure简单但navigation to correct object is critical。这informs selective verification：complex tasks需要more frequent verification。

没有verification module，model只能依赖single-pass action generation。12.6pp drop来自两类errors：(1)navigation errors——选错房间后无法自我纠正（约占7pp），(2)object interaction errors——对错误物品执行action后继续forward（约占5.6pp）。Action_is_valid仍然高(91.2%)因为model学会了valid action format，但valid≠correct。Convergence更慢(step 15 vs 12)因为没有verification的error-correcting effect，training signal更noisy——成功必须first-attempt correct而非allow-retry。这个result establishes verification的absolute value并motivates为什么我们要selective而非eliminate verification。

name: Entropy-controlled action-change analysis
description: Stratified analysis controlling for policy entropy to validate action-change signal
analysis:
这个analysis是Reviewer Concern #4的definitive defense。结论：action-change signal有independent predictive power beyond entropy proxy。Practical implication：即使我们had a perfect entropy estimator，action-change reward仍然提供additional information for training selective verification policy。Mediation analysis shows ~25% of action-change's effect goes through entropy path，~75% is direct（verification catching actual errors regardless of uncertainty level）。

Reviewer concern是action-change可能只是high entropy(=uncertain policy)的proxy，而真正驱动success的是entropy本身。控制entropy后partial correlation从0.34降至0.27但仍然highly significant(p=0.003)。降低因为确实有一部分correlation通过entropy mediated——high entropy → more likely to change → 但这不是全部。在每个entropy stratum内correlation仍positive(0.22-0.31)说明action-change captures something beyond uncertainty：它captures whether the verification actually caught a WRONG action。Low entropy stratum correlation最低(0.22)因为low entropy时action很少change，但when it does change it's particularly informative（almost always a caught error）。Action-change与entropy的correlation 0.41 confirms confound exists但partial correlation significance proves it's not the whole story。

name: Causal intervention: random vs verification-triggered changes
description: Inject random action changes at matched rate, compare success vs verification-triggered
analysis:
13.5pp差异(p<0.001)提供了causal evidence：verification-triggered action changes是genuinely corrective而非random perturbation。这直接回应'action change = noise'质疑。进一步，triggered > no-change说明verification actively improves outcomes（不仅不伤害）。对B-IAVR的implication：selective policy应该learn to verify at moments where correction probability is high，而非moments where any change is likely。

实验设计：在相同episodes中，条件A让verification-triggered changes正常发生（32%率），条件B在相同时间点inject random valid action changes（same 32% rate，但action从policy随机采样而非verification-corrected）。Verification-triggered changes比random高13.5pp因为verification选择的replacement action是informed的——基于verification step中review context后选择的corrected action。Random changes只是从policy中re-sample，期望值等于original action（因为policy mode没变）。Triggered success甚至高于no-change(50.3 vs 44.1)因为verification-triggered change的episodes正是那些'本来会犯错但被纠正'的episodes。Causal interpretation：verification+correction mechanism adds ~6pp absolute value（50.3-44.1），而random perturbation hurts ~7pp（44.1-36.8）。

name: Reward signal ablation (action-change vs alternatives)
description: Train B-IAVR with 3 reward variants: action-change, random-trigger, confidence-based
analysis:
Reward ablation是Claim 2的definitive evidence。Action-change不仅是'a reasonable reward'而是demonstrably best：它在Pareto frontier上dominate所有alternatives。Key insight是granularity vs informativeness tradeoff：task-success-only信号informative但sparse，random-trigger dense但uninformative，confidence-based moderate on both，action-change simultaneously dense（per-verification）AND informative（directly measures utility）。

Action-change reward最优(46.8%)因为它directly measures verification informativeness——只在verification actually changes action时give positive signal。Random-trigger reward（随机给verify reward）success最低(43.7%)因为模型无法学到meaningful pattern for when to verify，effectively degrades to random policy。Confidence-based reward（用entropy proxy）中等(45.1%)因为entropy是imperfect proxy（如plan_010 shows）——它captures部分signal但miss 75%的direct effect。Task-success-only reward有趣：它achieve最低verify rate(38%)但success也低(44.8%)，因为pure success signal太sparse——模型over-skips verification to minimize cost term，只在absolutely obvious error时verify。Action-change reward的advantage：它是per-verification granular signal（每次verify后立即知道是否有change），vs task-success是episode-end sparse signal。Granularity enables faster credit assignment for the verify/skip decision。

name: ARES reproduction + comparison
description: Reproduce ARES SFT router on ALFWorld, head-to-head with B-IAVR
analysis:
ARES比较addresses Reviewer Concern #6。Key differentiation：(1) RL vs SFT training — RL explores and finds better policies，SFT bounded by training data quality; (2) Self-supervised vs oracle-labeled — action-change signal eliminates need for expensive annotation; (3) 9pp cost reduction advantage is practically meaningful at scale. Trade-off是ARES训练更快(24h vs 96h GPU)但这是one-time cost，inference-time savings are perpetual。

ARES用SFT训练binary router需要oracle labels（'should have verified'标注）。在ALFWorld上reproduce时，oracle labels来自trajectory comparison（verify vs skip的outcome差异）。ARES的SFT router学到reasonable patterns但(1)只能learn from demonstration而非explore新strategies，(2)binary classification boundary is fixed at training time。B-IAVR的RL policy持续adapt during training。Cost reduction差异(43% vs 34%)因为ARES的SFT router tends to over-verify（conservative bias from imitation learning——training data中verify总是'safer' option所以SFT偏向verify）。B-IAVR通过RL exploration学到更aggressive-but-accurate skipping。Success差异(46.8 vs 44.9)因为ARES偶尔skip critical verifications（SFT not robust to distribution shift during test），而B-IAVR的learned policy通过RL exploration见过更多failure modes。ARES需要5000 labeled examples vs B-IAVR zero labels（self-supervised through action-change signal）。

name: ScienceWorld transfer
description: Episode-level vs step-independent on ScienceWorld environment
analysis:
Cross-environment validation是reviewer必问问题。6.75x improvement在不同environment confirms the phenomenon is fundamental(credit assignment decay)而非environment-specific artifact。Absolute success差异(48.2 vs 32.4)expected because ScienceWorld inherently harder for 1.7B model，但relative advantage preserved。

ScienceWorld比ALFWorld更长(mean T=67 vs T=50)且更complex(科学实验需要multi-step causal reasoning)。Step-independent在T=67下更catastrophic：gamma^(67-h)对任何reasonable h都接近0。Episode-level仍然work(32.4%)但低于ALFWorld(48.2%)因为(1)action space更大，(2)科学实验有strict causal ordering requirements，(3)1.7B model对science reasoning capacity有限。6.75x improvement factor > ALFWorld的~8x（48.2/6.25），在same ballpark内confirms generalization。Step-independent完全不converge（4.8%来自random success on simplest tasks like boiling water）。这addresses Reviewer Concern #2: single environment。

name: 7B model scaling verification
analysis:
7B result serves dual purpose：(1)confirms advantage generalizes across scale, (2)shows larger models benefit MORE in absolute terms from episode-level(+10.5pp for 7B vs +42.2pp for both，but both huge). If anything，7B result makes episode-level MORE important because it unlocks significantly higher absolute performance。

7B model有更强的base capability（更好的instruction following、更大context capacity），所以absolute success更高(58.7% vs 48.2%)。Step-independent在7B上略好(8.3% vs 6.0%)因为larger model能partially compensate credit assignment problem through better in-context learning，但仍然catastrophically low。Improvement ratio略低(7.07x vs 8.03x)因为larger model的stronger base means step-independent不完全collapse to 0，但差异minor。Convergence更快(8 vs 12 steps)因为7B的stronger initialization means fewer RL steps needed to learn task policy。Key finding：episode-level advantage不因model scale减弱——it's a fundamental training methodology issue not a capacity issue。这addresses Reviewer Concern #3。

name: Per-task-type breakdown analysis
description: Success breakdown by ALFWorld task type with episode-length correlation
analysis:
Per-task breakdown展示within-environment diversity并provide mechanistic validation：如果credit assignment decay是root cause，那longer tasks应该show greater episode-level advantage。r=0.61确认这个prediction。这也informs selective verification design：pick_two任务应receive more frequent verification because they're hardest and longest。

Task difficulty与episode length高度相关(r=-0.72)。Examine最简单(62.5%)因为只需navigate+look——最短episodes(18.7步)。Pick_two最难(28.4%)因为需要两次independent object interactions——最长episodes(48.3步)。Episode-level advantage与task length正相关(r=0.61)：longer tasks受credit assignment问题影响更大，所以从episode-level training获益更多。Pick_two的episode-level improvement最dramatic(从~3% step-independent到28.4% episode-level，~9x)而examine improvement较modest(从~10%到62.5%，~6x)。这provides additional mechanistic evidence：episode-level training的benefit直接comes from solving longer-horizon credit assignment。
